newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pacifica to wrap up buy-out talks July 2.
newsitem.headline: Pacifica to wrap up buy-out talks July 2.

text.p: Philippine oil and mining firm Pacifica Inc hopes to finalise this week details of a buy-out proposal by Strategic Alliance Development Corp (Stradec), a unit of PT Citra of Indonesia, the president of Pacifica said.
Stradec wants to take majority stake in the oil and mining firm, Pacifica chairman and president Oliverio Laperal said at the company's annual shareholders' meeting on Monday.
"Hopefully, we will conclude the negotiations by July 2," he said, adding that Stradec wanted to buy shares of Pacifica at its par value of 0.005 pesos each.
Laperal said Pacifica planned to spin off its oil and mining businesses and venture into infrastructure development.
Pacifica shares were steady at 0.07 pesos at mid-session on Monday.
